data.long_meaning: Swetank is a Sanskrit and Hindu name that means 'sweet tank'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'swet' meaning 'sweet' and 'ank' meaning 'tank'. This name reflects the idea of being filled with sweetness and nectar, and evokes images of abundance and prosperity. The name Swetank carries the meaning “Sweet Tank” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Swetank usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet tank and live with faith, good character and purpose.
